newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Eletrobras eyes $300 mln Eurobond.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Eletrobras eyes $300 mln Eurobond.

text.p: Brazil's federally owned power firm Eletrobras plans to launch $300 million in Eurobonds by June, financial newspaper Gazeta Mercantil said.
The paper, citing Eletrobras financial director Paulo Roberto Ribeiro Pinto, said the power firm would do a roadshow for the bond in June and select a lead manager between now and then.
No maturity period or price information was mentioned.
Ribeiro Pinto told the paper that U.S. rating agencies Moody's Investor's Service Inc and Standard & Poor's Corp would give Eletrobras its first credit ratings sometime in May.
He ruled out the possibility of launching a level three American Depositary Receipt (ADR), saying the firm ran out of time to get its accounting standards in line with stringent U.S. requirements.
